description: This file defines the internal implementation of the LocalGrainDirectory class in Orleans, responsible for managing grain directory entries, handling silo membership changes, forwarding requests, and maintaining cache consistency within a silo in a distributed Orleans cluster.

classes.name: LocalGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implements the grain directory management within a silo, including registration, lookup, cache management, and handling silo membership changes.

classes.name: DirectoryMembership
classes.description: Represents the current membership state of silos in the cluster, including the ring list and cache set.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the directory service and subscribes to silo status events.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the directory service, clears data, and prepares for shutdown.

methods.name: AddServer
methods.description: Adds a new silo to the membership ring and updates internal structures.

methods.name: RemoveServer
methods.description: Removes a silo from the membership ring and updates internal structures.

methods.name: CalculateGrainDirectoryPartition
methods.description: Determines which silo owns the directory information for a given grain.

methods.name: CheckIfShouldForward
methods.description: Decides whether a request should be forwarded to another silo based on ownership.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous lookup for a grain's activation address, with forwarding if necessary.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Unregisters a grain activation, forwarding if necessary.
